name: [D14] Pin ancestry fallback diagnostics and simplify test scaffolding (M)
description:
PRD 00004, cycle 14 decision-gate follow-up. This task is prepared for operator-authorized recovery; do not start while the data_loss_risk pause is unresolved.

### Findings (verbatim)
- medium | B2: the non-Darwin search_only fallback PermissionError branch has no committed test; only an ad-hoc probe (00004-cycle-13-fallback-probe.json) exercised it | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/_files.py:415 | Consensus: 1/3
- medium | B5: O_SEARCH resolution inlined with a re-derived `access == os.O_RDONLY` check and a magic literal that is Darwin O_EXEC (SDK fcntl.h:162-163: O_SEARCH = O_EXEC|O_DIRECTORY); hoist to a module constant `_O_SEARCH: int | None` and branch on `is None` (also gives B2 a one-line patch hook); the test actor duplicates the same literal | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/_files.py:400 | Consensus: 1/3
- low | B4: fallback PermissionError passes a Path as filename so str(error) renders `PosixPath('...')` (probe evidence line 10) while every other message in the module renders the bare path; cli.py:462 emits str(error) | File: src/ovcaq/workflow/_files.py:420 | Consensus: 1/3
- low | B7: search test asserts child-hardcoded constants (`read_denied is True`, `search_fsync is True`, `euid != 0` already guaranteed by the skip) | File: tests/packaging/test_rework_13.py:220 | Consensus: 1/3
- low | B8: `_assert_installed`, `_identity`, `_prepare` duplicate test_rework_12.py near-verbatim (only the required module name differs) | File: tests/packaging/test_rework_13.py:19 | Consensus: 1/3

### Acceptance criteria
Every quoted finding no longer reproduces. Preserve all previously accepted crash/retry, exact-replay, peer-creation, directory-identity, state/backup-byte, and installed-wheel origin coverage. Force the no-search-descriptor path on the supported macOS host using real 0111 permissions. Pin failure exit, errno, cause and contextual path; preserve successful readable fallback behavior. A capability constant must preserve current effective Darwin flags, and cleanup must keep real permission/fsync, record/state, origin, and scenario-specific setup checks. Share only existing common test logic. Coordinate after the ancestry repair because file scopes overlap.

Evidence: dev/local/reviews/00004-workflow-core-v1-review-14.md; dev/local/reviews/00004-cycle-14-installed-handoff-probe.json; dev/local/reviews/ancestry_handoff_probe_14.py. Source authority remains P02-T06/P02-T07/P02-T09 and Phase B durable-boundary exit; no public schema/API expansion.
